'''Dr. Anna''' (Japanese: '''アンナ''' ''Anna'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP165|Hassle in the Castle]]''. She also appeared in the [[Ash & Pikachu]] manga.

==In animation==
Dr. Anna runs a clinic, along with her assistant [[Keiko]]. Here, people with injuries are treated through the help of {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Among the many Pokémon at the clinic is her {{p|Zubat}}, named "Mimi", which she uses to X-ray her patients to find out what is wrong with them.

One day, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} came along. Impressed with Mimi, {{an|Brock}} sent out his own {{TP|Brock|Zubat|Crobat}}. He asked Dr. Anna if she would be interested in letting him help out at the clinic, and she agreed.

After {{TRT}} attacked, Brock sent out Zubat to stop them. During the {{pkmn|battle}}, his Zubat evolved into {{p|Golbat}}. After it used {{m|Supersonic}}, Dr. Anna's machine—which she used to scan patients—broke. After Team Rocket was sent blasting off, Dr. Anna told Brock that she couldn't have him helping her out, since Golbat's Supersonic was far too powerful. Heartbroken once again, Brock continued on with Ash and {{an|Misty}}.

She first appeared helping a patient with her Supersonic. {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}} and {{an|Brock}} arrived at that moment, and after seeing Mimi, Brock sent out his own {{TP|Brock|Zubat|Crobat}} to help. Whilst {{TRT}} were caught stealing food, Brock, Dr. Anna and both of the Zubat hunted them down, but fell down a hole into a strange maze.

To navigate through the maze, Anna and Brock ordered their Zubat to use Supersonic and generate a map of the maze. The Zubat eventually found the exit. But before they got out, Team Rocket nabbed both Zubat, but the huge explosion caused by [[Brock's Pineco]] freed them and they were reunited with their Trainers.

Mimi's only known move is {{m|Supersonic}}.}}

==In the manga==
[[File:Anna AP.png|thumb|200px|Anna in the Ash & Pikachu manga]]
===Ash & Pikachu===
Dr. Anna appears in ''[[SP03|Treasure Hunting?! Try The Maze!]]'', where she is simply known by "Anna" or "Miss Anna". Like in {{aniseries|GS}}, she works at a health clinic which uses Pokémon to help their patients. She is part of the tenth generation of her family to operate the Pokémon health clinic out of their castle.
